meta.title: Order Activity records a surrogate bid added
gaps: Verify the activity entry identifies the exact buyer actor and date/time.
Verify all earlier activity entries are present and ordered chronologically.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the activity entry identifies the exact buyer actor and date/time.; Verify all earlier activity entries are present and ordered chronologically.

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage's Order Activity can be tested.
Use an RFQ stage, which supports surrogate bidding and its stage Settings menu.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Add one product for the surrogate bid.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor so a surrogate bid can be entered for an eligible participant.
Publish the event so the RFQ is live and accepts bids.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Add a bid from the buyer console on behalf of the invited QA vendor, creating the activity to inspect.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted before checking its history.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Assert that the activity history contains a record describing the surrogate bid.
